Gives the highest value of [Dither](Dither) that does something, which is 1 on every driver. It was 2 on GPUs that could blend in the fragment shader until Dither 2 was removed; the function stays so that programs that call it still run. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such function.
@returns 1.
